headline: Sloppy Brazil held by Morocco 1-1 in their World Cup opener
summary: Morocco took an early lead, but Vinicius Jr's impressive goal secured a draw for Brazil. The South American giants struggled to break down Morocco's defense despite improving in the second half.
details: Brazil were held to a 1-1 draw by Morocco in their World Cup Group C opener on Saturday. Vinicius Jr's fine strike cancelled out an earlier goal from Ismael Saibari.
Morocco made a brighter start and took the lead in the 21st minute when Saibari finished a swift counter-attack. He raced through the middle to convert Brahim Diaz's through ball.
Vinicius Jr equalized for Brazil in the 32nd minute with a moment of quality. He cut in from the left and curled a right-footed shot into the top corner.

Brazil improved after halftime following several substitutions by coach Carlo Ancelotti, pressing higher and enjoying more possession. However, they struggled to break down Morocco's low block, resulting in both sides earning a point.
caption:
Brazil kicked off their World Cup campaign with a surprising 1-1 draw against Morocco. Vinicius Jr's brilliant goal salvaged a point for the South American giants.

Brazil were held to a 1-1 draw by Morocco in their World Cup Group C opener on Saturday. Vinicius Jr's fine strike cancelled out an earlier goal from Ismael Saibari.

Morocco made a brighter start and took the lead in the 21st minute when Saibari finished a swift counter-attack. He raced through the middle to convert Brahim Diaz's through ball.

Vinicius Jr equalized for Brazil in the 32nd minute with a moment of quality. He cut in from the left and curled a right-footed shot into the top corner.

Brazil improved after halftime following several substitutions by coach Carlo Ancelotti, pressing higher and enjoying more possession. However, they struggled to break down Morocco's low block, resulting in both sides earning a point.

headline: Bangladeshi stars Bubly and Apu Biswas unite in support for Brazil ahead of FIFA World Cup 2026
summary: Actresses Bubly and Apu Biswas, known for their on-screen rivalry, are seen sporting Brazil jerseys, highlighting their shared passion for the five-time World Cup champions.
details: Bangladeshi actresses Bubly and Apu Biswas have both publicly shown their support for the Brazil national football team ahead of the FIFA World Cup 2026. This comes as a notable moment, given their often-discussed professional rivalry.

In separate instances, both stars were seen donning the iconic yellow and green jerseys of the five-time World Cup champions. Their shared allegiance highlights a common passion for football among Bangladeshi celebrities.

The images, circulating widely, have drawn attention from fans who appreciate seeing their favorite stars unite over a shared love for the sport. This also sparks excitement for the upcoming global tournament.
